import ctypes as c, ctypes.util, pathlib, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
C=c.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('cairo'))
def api(n,restype,args):
 f=getattr(C,n); f.restype=restype; f.argtypes=args; return f
ptr=c.c_void_p; D=c.c_double; I=c.c_int
surface=api('cairo_image_surface_create',ptr,[I,I,I])(0,1200,500)
ctx=api('cairo_create',ptr,[ptr])(surface)
api('cairo_select_font_face',None,[ptr,c.c_char_p,I,I])(ctx,b'Noto Serif Display',0,0)
api('cairo_set_font_size',None,[ptr,D])(ctx,120)
class H(c.Structure): _fields_=[('type',I),('length',I)]
class P(c.Structure): _fields_=[('x',D),('y',D)]
class Data(c.Union): _fields_=[('header',H),('point',P)]
class Path(c.Structure): _fields_=[('status',I),('data',c.POINTER(Data)),('num_data',I)]
copy=api('cairo_copy_path',c.POINTER(Path),[ptr]); destroy=api('cairo_path_destroy',None,[c.POINTER(Path)])
move=api('cairo_move_to',None,[ptr,D,D]); text=api('cairo_text_path',None,[ptr,c.c_char_p]); new=api('cairo_new_path',None,[ptr])
class Ext(c.Structure): _fields_=[(n,D) for n in ['x_bearing','y_bearing','width','height','x_advance','y_advance']]
ext=api('cairo_text_extents',None,[ptr,c.c_char_p,c.POINTER(Ext)])
def fmt(v):return f'{v:.2f}'.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
def glyph(ch,x,y):
 new(ctx); move(ctx,x,y); text(ctx,ch.encode()); p=copy(ctx); out=[]; j=0
 while j<p.contents.num_data:
  h=p.contents.data[j].header; pts=[p.contents.data[j+k].point for k in range(1,h.length)]
  if h.type==0:out.append('M'+' '.join(map(fmt,[pts[0].x,pts[0].y])))
  elif h.type==1:out.append('L'+' '.join(map(fmt,[pts[0].x,pts[0].y])))
  elif h.type==2:out.append('C'+' '.join(fmt(v) for q in pts for v in (q.x,q.y)))
  elif h.type==3:out.append('Z')
  j+=h.length
 destroy(p); return ''.join(out)
x=184; baseline=144; letters=[]
# Optical spacing: tighten the open F/e and r/n pairs; open the w/a join.
adjust=[-4,-1.5,-2,-1,-1,0,-1.5]
for ch,k in zip('Fernway',adjust):
 letters.append(glyph(ch,x,baseline)); e=Ext();ext(ctx,ch.encode(),c.byref(e));x+=e.x_advance+k
print('word end',x)
mark='M4 15V10.5C2 10 1 8.6 1 6.5C2.2 6.5 3.2 7 4 7.7V5C4 2.4 6.4 1 9 1H15C15 4.1 12.4 6 9 6H6V8.5C7.6 7.5 9.5 7 12 7H13C13 9.8 10.4 11.5 7.5 11.5H6V15Z'
# Display mark is optically balanced against the serif cap height.
base=pathlib.Path.cwd()
def svg(title,desc,body,vb,w,h,color):
 return f'<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"{w}\" height=\"{h}\" viewBox=\"{vb}\" role=\"img\" aria-labelledby=\"title desc\">\\n  <title id=\"title\">{title}</title>\\n  <desc id=\"desc\">{desc}</desc>\\n  <style>:root{{color:{color}}}@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){{:root{{color:#f2ecdc}}}}</style>\\n  <g fill=\"currentColor\">\\n{body}\\n  </g>\\n</svg>\\n'
word='\\n'.join(f'    <path d=\"{p}\"/>' for p in letters)
body=f'    <path transform=\"translate(24 39) scale(7)\" d=\"{mark}\"/>\\n'+word
# Main asset is transparent and contains only the symbol and outlined name.
width=int(x+22)
(base/'logo.svg').write_text(svg('Fernway','Fern-shaped F and a serif Fernway wordmark.',body,f'0 0 {width} 200',width,200,'#214b3c'))
(base/'mark.svg').write_text(svg('Fernway','Fern-shaped F, simplified for use as a 16-pixel favicon.',f'    <path d=\"{mark}\"/>','0 0 16 16',16,16,'#214b3c'))
(base/'logo-reversed.svg').write_text(svg('Fernway','Light Fernway logo for dark backgrounds.',body,f'0 0 {width} 200',width,200,'#f2ecdc').replace('@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{color:#f2ecdc}}',''))
